dahlonega-first-gold-rush.text: Twenty years before California's gold rush of 1849, thousands of prospectors came into the Cherokee Nation in north Georgia: the beginning of the country's first gold rush.
dahlonega-first-gold-rush.source: Georgia State Parks, Dahlonega Gold Museum Historic Site
dahlonega-first-gold-rush.quote: Twenty years before the 1849 gold rush in California, thousands of prospectors flocked into the Cherokee Nation in north Georgia, marking the true beginning of our country’s first gold rush.

dahlonega-courthouse-1836.text: The Dahlonega Gold Museum is housed in the 1836 Lumpkin County Courthouse, one of the oldest courthouse buildings in Georgia.
dahlonega-courthouse-1836.source: Georgia State Parks, Dahlonega Gold Museum Historic Site
dahlonega-courthouse-1836.quote: The museum is housed inside the 1836 Lumpkin County Courthouse, one of the oldest courthouse buildings in Georgia.
